rules.statement: The doctrine of enormis laesio does not apply when the transaction is not a sale and there was no consideration passed or intended to pass.
rules.supporting_quote: There is, therefore, no room for the application of the doctrine of enormis Icesio,1[Voet 18, 5, 16, and Juta's Digest, vol. II. , col. 2583.] as the transaction was not a sale at all.
